subject: [RFC PATCH v2 02/18] splice: don't steal page cache folios

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the lack of description of the change's impact, specifically regarding potential slowdowns and increased memory consumption. Also requested historical context on why stealing was added in the first place.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Provided additional context on the change, explaining that SPLICE_F_MOVE has not moved page cache folios between files since 2007 and only fuse and virtio_console's splice_write() functions still steal from a pipe. Asked for input from other reviewers.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This RFC patch series proposes to remove the ability for splice operations to steal page cache folios, which are then reused without being freed. The change affects fuse and virtio_console's splice_write() functions, causing them to copy instead of move the folios. The motivation behind this change is to prevent potential issues with disk block reuse and file system corruption.
